nominal_identity.convention: External h/bf/lip/t and published inner radius ri; uniform thin wall on the rounded midsurface, quarter-circles approximated by chords. Origin is the intersection of the unrounded web/lower-flange midlines, x toward the open side and y upward. J=integral(t^3 ds)/3. Gross elastic geometry, not effective widths or an INSTAB reconstruction.

material_origin.fyb_fya: Explicit requested nominal yield, no enhancement or product verification

Mx_positive.proof: EN13 5.5.2/5.5.3/6.1.4.1(4); EN15 Table4.1/4.2. Every local rho=1 and compressed physical As exact Eq5.17 cap=1. Tensile-lip mixed flanges require a separate free-outstand majorant.
Mx_positive.fixed_point_statement: All widths and thicknesses unchanged at the pure-ULS reference; therefore same stress field on re-evaluation.
Mx_positive.assembly_interpretation: Inherited EN stiffener-as-column model: wholly compressed physical As; kr=As2/As1 when both exist, kr=0 only for the wholly tensile opposite assembly. Not a coupled translating-junction eigenmode proof.
Mx_positive.coefficient_origin: Gross centroid of this rounded contour; multiply SIGNED action
